test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Modesty or shyness resulting from a lack of self-confidence
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"modesty"** means the quality of being modest; it reflects humility or a lack of arrogance. (नम्रता)

 
 
• **Example:** Her **modesty **was evident when she downplayed her achievements.
 
 
 
• **"Shyness"** refers to the feeling of being nervous or timid in the presence of other people. (संकोच)
 
 
• **Example:** His **shyness** made it difficult for him to speak in public.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the combination of modesty and shyness, especially due to a lack of self-confidence, is best described by the term **"Diffidence"**. (संकोच या आत्मविश्वास की कमी)
 
 
• **Example:** Her **diffidence** kept her from volunteering for the leadership role.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Diffidence**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Assurance** (आश्वासन): Confidence or certainty in one’s abilities or in a situation.

 
 
• **Example:** She spoke with assurance about her plans for the future.
 
 
 
• **Determination** (दृढ़ संकल्प): Firmness of purpose; resoluteness.
 
 
• **Example:** His determination to succeed was evident in his relentless effort.
 
 
 
• **Conviction** (आस्था): A firmly held belief or opinion.
 
 
• **Example:** Her conviction in her principles never wavered.
 
 

 

31a:Ta17,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
